title: PERMAFLEET officer recruiting
description: Puts a Prospect IV forward for PERMAFLEET officer training (offered by the recruiting campaign in contracts/recruiting.json). Answers are recorded per member for PERMAFLEET leadership, who select who trains.

welcome.say: Hi {{user.name}}! Your answers go to PERMAFLEET leadership, who select who trains as a **PERMAFLEET OFFICER**. Nothing is sent until you confirm at the end, and Cancel stops at any point.

leadership.say: Have you led in Star Citizen before?

options.label: Ops and events
options.description: I run or call ops regularly

options.label: Org leadership
options.description: Officer or founder of an org

interests.say: What would you like to take on? Pick everything that fits.

options.label: I'd rather not lead on voice

hours.say: How much time a week could you give to officer work?

org.say: Which PERMAFLEET member org do you fly with? Skip if it's PERMAFLEET itself.

when.say: When do you usually play (your local time)? Pick everything that fits.

handle.say: What's your RSI handle? It's the name in your RSI profile link (robertsspaceindustries.com/citizens/<handle>).

notes.say: Anything leadership should know? Ops you've run, orgs you've led, someone who can vouch for you. Skip if not.

complete.say: Sent. PERMAFLEET leadership reviews every name and selects who trains as an officer; you'll hear from them on Discord. Until then, keep showing up for ops: {{context.siteUrl|https://goon.vc}}/operations/PERMAFLEET/schedule

cancelled.say: No problem, nothing was sent. If you change your mind, ask in the PERMAFLEET Discord about officer training.
